subject.title: feat: sign stored OpenClaw catalog publications

question: Should `/api/v1/feeds/plugins` immediately replace its established unsigned JSON representation with DSSE, or should ClawHub retain that representation while introducing an explicitly negotiated or versioned signed response until the OpenClaw trust rollout lands?
rationale: This choice defines a public client compatibility and trust boundary; the patch can mechanically preserve the existing route, but maintainers must choose the permanent rollout contract and deployment order.

options.title: Stage a compatible DSSE rollout
options.body: Keep the current JSON response available and add a negotiated or versioned DSSE representation with focused compatibility and production-path proof.

options.title: Approve an immediate replacement
options.body: Accept the DSSE-only response and required signing configuration on the canonical route, with explicit ownership of breaking old clients and rollout operations.

options.title: Pause until the consumer rollout is ready
options.body: Defer producer changes until the public key, OpenClaw consumer, and production provisioning sequence can land as one reviewed rollout.

recommendation.title: Stage a compatible DSSE rollout
recommendation.body: Keep the current JSON response available and add a negotiated or versioned DSSE representation with focused compatibility and production-path proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged hosted-feed contract whose public representation and rollout boundary this PR changes.
